ax5.set_title('Average Income by Marital Status')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

ax6 = axes[1, 2]
df['HasChildren'] = (df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']).apply(lambda x: 'Has Children' if x > 0 else 'No Children')
children_spending = df.groupby('HasChildren')['TotalSpending'].mean()
bars = ax6.bar(children_spending.index, children_spending.values, color=[colors[0], colors[3]], edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Household Status')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)')
ax6.set_title('Spending: Children vs No Children')
for bar, val in zip(bars, children_spending.values):
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 10, f'${val:.0f}', ha='center', fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
